result.summary:
Fixed two bugs in the pagination source (tests untouched):

1. src/pages.js:8-17 — `pages()` emitted an ellipsis whenever the window didn't touch the first/last page, even when the gap was a single page. Now it computes leftGap/rightGap and only pushes "…" when the gap is ≥ 2 pages; otherwise it widens the window to include the adjacent page (e.g. pages(4,10) → [1,2,3,4,5,'…',10], pages(5,8) → [1,'…',4,5,6,7,8]).

2. src/Pagination.jsx:21 — the Next button used `disabled={current > total}`, so it was never disabled on the last page. Changed to `disabled={current >= total}`.
